text:
marta: Heads-up: during a planned FIPS toggle in ap-southeast-1 the keystore mirror started returning 403 for cross-account replication; a few staging GPUs couldn't decrypt while joining warm pool.
ash: saw three nodes stuck at 'decrypting' and then marked unhealthy by the join controller. autoscaler drained them.
ops-bot: Incident INT-APAC-FIPS-1758887776 created and paged infra/sre/security.
kevin: immediate mitigation option: add a short-lived privatelink allowlist for replication traffic from staging CIDR 10.77.20.0/26 so keystore can push. need security OK + PR in infra repo.
lia: OK to consider short exception but require: 1) SIEM logging enabled for that path, 2) infra PR with revert TTL, 3) approval recorded in compliance tracker.
marta: agreed. I'll draft the PR. keep window minimal (15-25 minutes). also capture cost impact: warm pool churn billed for ~N minutes of g4dn usage.
frank: snippet for infra PR (terraform):

```
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "keystore_replica_temp" {
  type = "ingress"
  from_port = 443
  to_port = 443
  protocol = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.77.20.0/26"]
  security_group_id = var.keystore_pl_sg
  description = "temporary allow for keystore replication from apac staging"
}
```

ash: add tags: {"incident":"INT-APAC-FIPS-1758887776","approver":"lia"} so change tools pick it up.
kevin: PR opened: https://git.company/infra/PR/1987 (includes SIEM toggle + revert timer). Waiting for apply.
marta: applying in 1m. ops-bot will monitor replication metrics.
ops-bot: terraform apply started for staging-privatelink 1 plan: 1 to add.
lia: approval recorded in compliance tracker. condition: rotate any key material if accessed during the window.
frank: replication resumed ~30s after rule applied; two nodes finished decrypt and joined. warm pool back to target capacity.
kevin: setting automatic rollback in 20m. if we need extension, will require new approval.
nash: follow-ups: - add synthetic check for keystore replication success - make client tolerate transient 403s during FIPS transitions with exponential backoff - surface replication failures into onboarding pipeline so we failover to eu model variant automatically.
marta: filing incident summary and owners for follow-ups. closing once ACL reverted and postmortem created. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
